01 About the organisation

A professionally managed implementation partner for CSR, environment and infrastructure projects.

CAK Enterprise Private Limited works with corporate, institutional, government, NGO and community stakeholders to plan and implement projects that create measurable social and environmental impact.

We provide end-to-end project support planning, procurement, execution, field implementation, manpower coordination, documentation, monitoring and reporting so that a CSR commitment turns into a finished, working project on the ground.
